info.title: ONESOURCE Trust Tax Administration
info.description: Administration APIs allow authenticated ONESOURCE Trust Tax users to retrieve a paginated list of Users, Custom Fields for a specific PAN. It also allows you to filter and sort the data using OData query specifications.

get.summary: Retrieves users for a client and pan
get.description: Allows authenticated users to access the User data by specific PAN for a Client
get.operationId: Allows authenticated users to access the User data by specific PAN for a Client

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: The client key.

parameters.name: pan
parameters.description: The pan.

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Limits the properties returned in the result.

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: Indicates the related entities to be represented inline. The maximum depth is 2.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: Restricts the set of items returned. The maximum number of expressions is 100. The allowed functions are: allfunctions.

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Specifies the order in which items are returned. The maximum number of expressions is 5.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Limits the number of items returned from a collection.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Excludes the specified number of items of the queried collection from the result.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: Indicates whether the total count of items within a collection are returned in the result.
